p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687659/attempts/4b6740fb5c394cfaab2dd4985d9f6926/system/state/workspace/programs/task-bb8363a9.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    # The non-background color forms a stencil. Paint every translated copy
    # whose stencil cells are all zero in the original grid.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 6)}
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = next(iter(colors))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    maxr = max(r for r, c in shape)
    maxc = max(c for r, c in shape)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-maxr):
        for c in range(w-maxc):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
'''
